mechanism: Infliximab (TNF-alpha inhibitor) may impair immune response and reduce efficacy of praziquantel against parasitic infections by suppressing Th1 and Th2 immune responses required for parasite clearance.
action: Monitor treatment efficacy closely; consider delaying elective praziquantel therapy until after completion of infliximab induction therapy or assess necessity of concurrent use in patients with active parasitic infections.
